Good Morning Brother

Chapter 1

High Fantasy Magic Mystery

"Good morning, brother!" an annoying voice piped right beside his ear. "Morning, morning, MORNING!"

Zorian grimaced, pulling the pillow over his head in a futile attempt to block the auditory assault.

Unfortunately for him, his younger sister Kirielle was not someone easily deterred by mere pillows. She immediately launched herself onto his bed, bouncing vigorously.

The time loop of Cyoria was quietly ticking down in the shadows of the academy gates.
